exams.notes: Examination required under WV Code 16-4C-1 et seq.; veterans with military EMS training may take the same examination. Additional training may be required if more than 30 years has passed since military training completion.

available.quote: Any person who has served on reserve or active duty in the medical corps of any of the Armed Forces of the United States and who has successfully completed the course of instruction required to qualify him or her for rating as an emergency medical technician, hospital corpsman, combat medic, health care specialist, or other equivalent rating in his or her particular branch of the Armed Forces ... may submit to the West Virginia Office of Emergency Medical Services

requirements.value: Military veterans with qualifying EMS training (EMT, hospital corpsman, combat medic, health care specialist, or equivalent) who served under honorable conditions may apply to take the state examination. Additional training may be required if more than 30 years has passed since completion of military training.
requirements.quote: the veteran may be required to attend additional training courses prior to taking the examination if more than 30 years has passed from his or her successful completion of the course of instruction and date of application

military_veteran_licensure_pathway.quote: Any person who has served on reserve or active duty in the medical corps of any of the Armed Forces of the United States and who has successfully completed the course of instruction required to qualify him or her for rating as an emergency medical technician, hospital corpsman, combat medic, health care specialist, or other equivalent rating in his or her particular branch of the Armed Forces, and whose service in the Armed Forces was under honorable conditions, may submit to the West Virginia Office of Emergency Medical Services
